references.text: Joshua captured Makkedah on that same day and struck the city and its king with the sword. He devoted them to destruction, along with everyone in it.
Joshua set an ambush against Bethel, and the Israelites took the city. This is why the king of Bethel is listed among the defeated kings.
Bethel was originally called Luz, but Jacob renamed it Bethel ('House of God') after his dream of a ladder reaching to heaven.
Abraham camped between Bethel and Ai and built an altar to the Lord there. Bethel was an important place in the history of the patriarchs.
The descendants of Joseph took Bethel, which was formerly called Luz. This adds detail to the account of the conquest of Bethel.
